instruction: Make an order for 3 'Modern Ceramic Table Lamp's, 2 'Nintendo Switch OLED Model's, and 4 'KALLAX Shelf Unit's from amazon for my father's home address.
notes: Father's home address is looked up via phone.search_contacts(relationship=father) and registered on Amazon with amazon.add_address (the evaluation ignores Address additions and only forbids updates/deletes; if amazon.show_addresses already lists the father's address the agent may reuse that address_id instead). amazon.clear_cart runs before any add so the placed order contains exactly the three requested products with exact quantities (CartEntry changes are ignored by evaluation). (in-cart ?p ?q) is a session-history fact: add-product-to-cart is blocked after (checkout-done), so the goal's in-cart facts plus (order-placed order-1 father-amazon-address-id) guarantee the order holds the three items. supervisor-complete-task takes only non-API record parameters (three distinct products with their quantities, the order and address) so its precondition equals the task goal; no answer is passed since the task is not a question. Product ids are discovered by amazon.search_products and the payment card by amazon.show_payment_cards.

plan: (amazon-add-address father-address-name father-street father-city father-state father-country father-zip amazon-token father-home-address father-amazon-address-id)
